title: Utility difficulty and child-care work prevention sit beside following-month renter insecurity
source_unit: identified SIPP renter reference-parent person pair with utility condition at month t, annual child-care work-prevention status and following outcomes at month t+1

observations.period: 2024 reference year; November-to-December; utility difficulty, renter, care not prevented
observations.method: Same-person adjacent-month descriptive comparison using November WPFINWGT and 240 Fay-BRR replicate weights; resource movement is any income-to-poverty-band crossing.
observations.uncertainty: Utility and care fields may be reference-period measures; separate valid outcome universes are retained and no dated bill is observed.
observations.subgroup: Renter reference-parent pairs with utility difficulty and no reported child-care work prevention.
observations.counterinterpretation: Housing, family, work, health, and material selection may explain the surface; no utility or care effect is estimated.

observations.period: 2024 reference year; November-to-December; utility difficulty, renter, care prevented
observations.method: Same-person adjacent-month descriptive comparison using November WPFINWGT and 240 Fay-BRR replicate weights; resource movement is any income-to-poverty-band crossing.
observations.uncertainty: Prevention cell has only 12 records and wide intervals; all outcomes are diagnostic rather than stable rankings.
observations.subgroup: Renter reference-parent pairs with utility difficulty and reported child-care work prevention.
observations.counterinterpretation: A joint-constraint screen cannot separate utilities, housing, care, work, or unobserved resources; it does not estimate a causal effect.

related_sources.claim: Defines the full 2,600-pair bridge, separate outcomes, and owner/buyer counter-surfaces.
Places SIPP monthly work/care/resource fields beside complementary MEPS and ATUS clocks.
Official definitions and universes for utility, tenure, care-prevention, food, hardship, and resource fields.

reproduction_audit.result: The two selected renter observations reproduce the local bridge output; raw inputs remain outside the repository.
reproduction_audit.interpretation: This is an adjacent-month descriptive joint-constraint screen, not a dated bill event, causal effect, household prevalence estimate, recovery result, remedy result, trust result, or political-action result.

boundary: This selected renter layer places utility difficulty and tenure at month t beside annual fall child-care work prevention and following-month housing hardship, food insecurity, and resource-band movement. The care field is not newly observed in the following month; utility difficulty is not a bill or shutoff; the prevention cell is small. No causal, recovery, remedy, trust, political-action, or exit claim is made.
